item.tib: khro bo rol pa'i smad bam las rtsis rgya bstan
item.coloph: khrol bo rol pa'i rgyud chen 'di/ bdud srid log pa gcod phyir du/ dur khrod lang tang nag po ru/ khro rgyal khrag 'thung chen po nyid/ mngon skur bzhengs te gsung bsgrags nas/ stag la me 'bar nyid la bshad/ gshen rab thugs kyi sras pa te/ stag la me 'bar bka' sgom mdzod (mdzad) / g.yung drung rig pa sras la brgyud/ stag gzigs rgya gar skad du bsgyur/ rgya gar nam mkha'i g.yas kyi zhug de mthu chen lnga la brgyud/ mkhas pa'i gshen bzhi/ li shu'i rgya skad tshang ma bod du bsgyar/ phyi rabs don du dkar chab btab/ gter du sbas te smon lam btab/ phyi rab (rabs) rnams kyi don gyur cig gter du brdol nas dar ba'o/ rim par rgyud nas bdag la'o// bkra shis par shog
